tools.description: Search the Meta Ad Library right now by keyword, in any market and language: the ads currently running, one per Facebook page, the longest running first. Use it only when the user explicitly asks for a live search or for the ads running now on Meta in a market or country; otherwise search Pantheon's public library first with search_ads_library and offer a live search as a next step. The ads are not classified: when you present them, add one short line per ad saying what it sells and its niche, from its text, and leave out the ads where the keyword is incidental (say which ones). Then call show_ad_cards with the ads you kept, in the order you present them, so the user sees them as cards. in_pantheon_catalog marks the pages Pantheon already has: search_ads_library gives their analyzed ads. To see every active ad of a page and its analysis (angles, awareness level, landing page fit), pass its page_id to run_competitor_spy (same niche) or run_inspiration_search (other niche). With offer_id the ads are ranked by affinity to that offer (0-1, affine = same niche as the radar's threshold), most affine first. Nothing is saved unless the user asks: then call save_live_ads with the search_id. When more_available is true and the user wants more, call it again with continue_search_id: it goes on from where that search stopped, with new pages only (calling it again with the same query would return the same ads). Each ad returned counts on the live search quota (up to about 30 ads per page of results).

continue_search_id.description: search_id of an earlier search with more_available true: fetches its next results (keyword, market and filters are taken from it; query can be omitted).

country.description: ISO country code of the market, e.g. FR, IT, US, or ALL (default ALL).

exclude_ecommerce.description: Set it when the user does not want e-commerce results: hides the ads Pantheon already knows as online shops (ecommerce true). Ads with ecommerce null are not classified: leave out yourself those that clearly sell physical products from a shop.

language.description: 2-letter language of the ads, e.g. fr, it, en. Default: the market's main language.

min_active_days.description: Keep only ads running for at least this many days (default 14).

offer_id.description: Optional radar offer id from list_radar_offers: ranks the ads by affinity to it.

pages.description: Pages of results to fetch (default 1, max 2): use 2 only when 1 gives too few pages.

query.description: Keyword or short phrase as people would write it in an ad, in the market's language (2-60 characters).
